display.purpose: Hero headlines only, one per page.

label.purpose: Section eyebrows, category tags, uppercase micro-labels.

shadows.name: shadow-xs
shadows.purpose: Resting form inputs on plain white — the one sanctioned non-purple shadow.

shadows.name: glass-card
shadows.purpose: Default glassmorphism card resting shadow, with an inset top highlight.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Product card hover, deepest lift in the system.

shadows.name: shadow-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary CTA ambient glow, pulses to 0 8px 36px rgba(124,58,237,.35).

motion.name: ease-signature
motion.purpose: The one spring curve for all interactive hover/expand/slide transitions — hover-lift, product-card, faq-card, pill-tab slider, lang-dropdown.

motion.name: ease-ambient-linear
motion.purpose: Reserved for ambient/infinite loops only — marquee, glow pulse, float. Never for interactive state changes.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Nav chevron rotate, color transitions, toggle switch.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Canonical filled CTA — used in navbar, hero, footer band.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; background: #5e2d91; color: #fff; border: none; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(124,58,237,0.08); transition: background 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4a2373; box-shadow: 0 32px 64px rgba(124,58,237,0.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(124,58,237,.35); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined companion to the primary button — login, secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; background: transparent; color: #111827; border: 2px solid #e5e7eb; transition: background .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f9fafb; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(124,58,237,.2); }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: The signature frosted card — trust signals, feature highlights, testimonials.
components.html:
Feature Card
Backdrop blur, white/70, subtle brand border.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,.7); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border: 1px solid rgba(124,58,237,.06); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.03), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6); padding: 24px; max-width: 320px; transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-glass-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 32px 64px rgba(124,58,237,.08), 0 0 0 1px rgba(124,58,237,.04); } .ds-glass-card-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #170926; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-glass-card-body { font-size: 13px; color: #6b7280; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Badge / Chip
components.description: Neutral inline pill; swap the palette to a laurenn-spectrum color only for a real status/category claim.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; background: #f5f3ff; color: #5e2d91; border: 1px solid #ddd6fe; }

components.name: FAQ Card
components.description: Canonical FAQ accordion item (supersedes the legacy .faq-item). Active state gets a brand-purple border and a rotated chevron.
components.html: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. No lock-in periods.
components.css: .ds-faq-card { border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; overflow: hidden; transition: border-color .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-faq-card--open { border-color: #5e2d91; } .ds-faq-card-button { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; padding: 16px 20px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-faq-card-question { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #170926; } .ds-faq-card-chevron { transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); flex-shrink: 0; color: #5e2d91; } .ds-faq-card--open .ds-faq-card-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-faq-card-answer { padding: 0 20px 16px; font-size: 14px; color: #6b7280; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-faq-card-button:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(124,58,237,.3); }

components.name: Billing Toggle
components.description: iOS-style switch for the monthly/yearly pricing toggle — distinct from Pill Tabs, which switch between product use-cases rather than a binary state.
components.css: .ds-toggle { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle-input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-toggle-track { width: 56px; height: 28px; background: #e5e7eb; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.06); position: relative; display: block; transition: background .2s; } .ds-toggle-thumb { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 24px; height: 24px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 9999px; transition: all .2s; } .ds-toggle-input:checked + .ds-toggle-track { background: #5e2d91; } .ds-toggle-input:checked + .ds-toggle-track .ds-toggle-thumb { transform: translateX(28px); border-color: #5e2d91; } .ds-toggle-input:focus-visible + .ds-toggle-track { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(124,58,237,.25); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Glass-style form field with a purple focus ring, consistent across auth/contact forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-width: 360px; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #6b7280; } .ds-field-control { border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; background: #fff; border-radius: 10px; transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; font-size: 15px; padding: 14px 16px; color: #111827; font-family: 'Google Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field-control:focus-within { border-color: #7c3aed; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(124,58,237,.12); }

narrative.overview: Rainbow's site renders enterprise trust through glass. Every primary surface — navigation, feature cards, testimonials, form inputs — sits behind frosted, blurred glassmorphism: white at 70-75% opacity, backdrop-blur, and a hairline border tinted with the brand purple rather than plain black. Behind that glass, soft radial blobs of purple and indigo drift in the negative space; they are ambient signal, not noise. One steady identity color (brand-500, #5e2d91) carries every moment that says "this is Rainbow" — logo, primary buttons, section badges, the hero word-shuffler. A second, more vibrant purple (brand-vibrant, #7c3aed) never competes with it; it is reserved for glass borders, glow shadows, and interactive accent states. A four-color "laurenn" spectrum (orange, pink, blue, green) is rationed even further: it shows up only as deliberate proof — certification badges, status pills, category tags — never as decoration. This restraint is the point: the product's real differentiator is compliance and sovereignty, and a system that spent its color budget freely would undercut that seriousness. Motion follows one signature spring curve everywhere it appears, so the whole surface feels like a single calm, confident signal rather than a collection of components.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted glass surfaces (blur + low-opacity white + purple-tinted hairline border) over ambient radial-gradient blobs
One identity purple (#5e2d91); a second vibrant purple for glow/border accents only; a 4-color spectrum rationed to proof moments
Tight letter-spacing (-0.03em to -0.02em) on every display/headline/title size
One spring easing curve (cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)) governs all interactive motion; linear is reserved for ambient/infinite loops
Purple-tinted shadows (rgba(124,58,237,…)), never pure black, on any elevated surface

rules.name: The One Purple Rule
rules.body: #5e2d91 is the only color allowed to say "this is Rainbow." #7c3aed is expressive, not identifying — it can glow and outline, but it may never appear on a logo, a primary CTA fill, or a text link.

rules.name: The Proof-Only Rule
rules.body: The laurenn spectrum appears exactly where the product is making a factual claim (certified, active, this category) — never as generic decoration or a section accent.

rules.name: The Tight Tracking Rule
rules.body: Every size at Title and above uses negative letter-spacing. A heading set at default tracking reads as an unfinished draft in this system, not a neutral choice.

rules.name: The Purple Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every elevated surface tints its shadow with rgba(124,58,237,…). Pure black shadows on this palette's purple/indigo surfaces read as muddy.

dos: Do use the signature spring, cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1), for every hover, expand, and slide transition.
Do tint every elevated surface's shadow with rgba(124,58,237,…) rather than black.
Do apply -0.03em to -0.02em letter-spacing on every Title-and-above heading.
Do use #5e2d91 for anything that identifies the brand: logo, primary buttons, active states, section badges.
Do reserve the laurenn spectrum (orange/pink/blue/green) for moments that state a real fact — a certification, a status, a category — never as a section accent chosen for variety.
Do build new FAQ UI on .faq-card, and new buttons on the Tailwind rounded-btn bg-brand-500 inline pattern.
donts: Don't use #7c3aed (brand.vibrant) as a brand-identifying color — logo, primary button fill, or body link. It's for glass borders, glows, and accent states only.
Don't mix ease-in-out/default easing into interactive transitions — reserve linear strictly for ambient/infinite loops (marquee, glow pulse, float).
Don't add a blob, gradient wash, or shine effect that isn't doing compositional work; if removing a decorative element makes the section read more clearly, remove it.
Don't extend .faq-item or .btn-cta-primary/.btn-cta-secondary in new work — both are legacy, kept only for the one page that still uses them.
Don't introduce a hard 0px corner anywhere; every surface in this system is soft-cornered, down to 4px at minimum.
